name: Emporos
appearance: A stout figure with kind eyes and calloused hands from handling goods. He wears a practical knee-length chiton in earthy brown, secured with a wide leather belt holding coin pouches and small tools. A colorful striped himation drapes over one shoulder, and his worn but sturdy sandals show many miles of travel. His graying beard is neatly braided, and he carries a walking staff topped with bronze rings that chime softly as he moves.
